templates.name: app_automation_workflow
templates.title: App 自动化决策流程
templates.description: 从钉钉打卡自动化中提取的通用决策模式。任何'自动操作App X'的任务都应走这个流程：先检查API可用性→无API则检查急速模式→仍不行则模拟点击→都不行则人工介入。避免在错误方向上探索。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: long_form_writer
templates.title: 万字长文生成器
templates.description: 分章节并行生成长文并自动拼接润色。工作流化解决单次LLM输出长度限制：先生成大纲→迭代生成每章→聚合→全文润色。适用于技术文档、分析报告、教程等。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: code_reviewer
templates.title: 代码审查与修复
templates.description: 标准代码审查工作流: 读取源码 → 运行测试 → 定位失败根因 → 最小修改 → 重新验证 → 生成报告。这是最核心的软件开发质量保证流程。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: task_decomposer
templates.title: 任务分解与规划
templates.description: 将复杂任务分解为可执行的子任务并按依赖排序。输入任务描述→LLM拆解→提取子任务→依赖排序→生成格式化计划。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: data_analyzer
templates.title: 数据分析流水线
templates.description: 标准数据分析工作流：加载数据→统计摘要→异常检测→生成报告。适用于CSV/JSON数据的自动化分析场景。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: document_summarizer
templates.title: 文档摘要生成器
templates.description: 阅读文档并生成多层级摘要：一句话总结→三段要点→完整摘要。适用于合同、论文、长文等场景。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: customer_support_router
templates.title: 智能客服路由
templates.description: 客服消息智能分类与差异化响应。将客户消息分为投诉/咨询/反馈/紧急四类，每类返回差异化响应。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: dingtalk_checkin
templates.title: 钉钉上班打卡 (8:45)
templates.description: 每日8:45触发钉钉上班打卡。schedule_trigger 定时 → HTTP Request 调用钉钉考勤API → 模板格式化结果。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: dingtalk_checkout
templates.title: 钉钉下班签退 (19:00)
templates.description: 每日19:00触发钉钉下班签退。schedule_trigger 定时 → HTTP Request 调用钉钉考勤API → 模板格式化结果。
templates.author: platform

templates.title: 钉钉智能打卡（双策略降级）

build_plan.goal: Build and validate an editable data analysis BlockFlow with inputs data_description and optional analysis_goal, producing statistical summary, anomaly notes, recommendations, structured statistics, and a reviewer-facing formatted report. End with outputs report and statistics.
build_plan.strategy: Use template_expand on data_analyzer (confidence 0.85) with deep reuse, then refine and add explicit architecture bricks per requirements.

modules.title: Core data analysis pipeline
modules.purpose: Expand data_analyzer template, configure inputs/outputs, statistical summary, anomaly detection, recommendations.
evidence: Template expanded with deep reuse: data_analyzer confidence 0.85
Added template_transform prompt builder to fix LLM variable resolution
Test passes with correct report and statistics output

modules.title: Structured statistics extraction
modules.purpose: Ensure parameter_extractor produces key_findings, record_count, anomalies_found from LLM output.
evidence: parameter_extractor correctly extracts record_count=500, anomalies_found=3, and key_findings from LLM analysis

modules.title: Reviewer-facing report formatting
modules.purpose: Template transform to produce formatted report for reviewer consumption.
evidence: template_transform produces a markdown-formatted reviewer-facing report with summary, statistics, and full analysis

modules.title: Mandatory tests
modules.purpose: Auditable workflow test with required_node_types, required_tool_nodes, structural assertions.
evidence: Mandatory test with required_node_types covers all required blocks, structural assertions pass on report and statistics output

risks: LLM output variability may cause structural assertions to fail without structural_only flag
parameter_extractor may not capture all required fields
Template may not include all required outputs (report, statistics)
